query:
UPDATE seller_profile_field_sources
         SET research_run_id = $4,
             component_key = $5
         WHERE id = (
             SELECT id
             FROM seller_profile_field_sources
             WHERE profile_id = $1
               AND seller_profile_try_normalize_field_path(field_path)
                   = seller_profile_normalize_field_path($2)
               AND created_by_user_id = $3
               AND metadata->'value' = $6::jsonb
             ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
             LIMIT 1
         )
